We read every public page - the pricing notes, the restriction lists, the support claims and the disclosures - and scored the platform on ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The verdict below is our own.
whatItClaims: Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
No prior trading experience required.
AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
whatWeChecked: The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.
The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.
The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.
The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Create the account with your contact details, then verify it through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Deposit the US$250 minimum by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Choose your risk level and trading mode, then use the demo to learn the dashboard.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: One figure doing two different jobs.
Return claims without verification.
Payout wording without processing detail.
No named regulator or licence.
redFlags: Support figures that contradict each other.
Template placeholders left unrendered.
Return claims without verification.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Where is The Agent Trades restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Is registration free?
faqs.a: Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

bottomLine: The verdict on the product is cautious approval: it works, it includes a demo, and it should be used with the minimum deposit while the claims are unproven.
The scorecard settles at 4.8. That is a cautious pass - proceed with the demo first, the minimum deposit second, and treat every payout figure as unproven until you see it yourself.
